findings.finding: Encouraging clients to identify their problems can enhance the urgency for them to seek solutions.

findings.finding: Inviting comments from potential clients indicates a strategy for fostering open communication and engagement.

findings.finding: Identifying and addressing the hardest objections in client discussions may improve sales effectiveness.
